+#!/bin/bash
+# Hook: Remind to update product docs after PR creation
+# Triggered by PostToolUse on Bash commands containing "gh pr create"
+
+INPUT=$(cat)
+COMMAND=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')
+
+# Only trigger on gh pr create commands
+if [[ "$COMMAND" != *"gh pr create"* ]]; then
+  exit 0
+fi
+
+# Get changed files relative to main branch
+CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff main...HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null || git diff origin/main...HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null || echo "")
+
+if [ -z "$CHANGED_FILES" ]; then
+  exit 0
+fi
+
+# Check if any changed files map to documented areas
+NEEDS_UPDATE=false
+AFFECTED_AREAS=""
+
+while IFS= read -r file; do
+  case "$file" in
+    components/canvas/*|store/canvas-*|hooks/use-canvas-*|app/*/canvas/*)
+      AFFECTED_AREAS="$AFFECTED_AREAS canvas"
+      NEEDS_UPDATE=true
+      ;;
+    components/video/*|store/video-*|app/*/video/*)
+      AFFECTED_AREAS="$AFFECTED_AREAS video"
+      NEEDS_UPDATE=true
+      ;;
+    actions/ai-tool*|components/ai-tool*|app/*/ai-tools/*)
+      AFFECTED_AREAS="$AFFECTED_AREAS ai-tools"
+      NEEDS_UPDATE=true
+      ;;
+    actions/comfyui/*|app/*/generate/*|store/sketch-to-image/*)
+      AFFECTED_AREAS="$AFFECTED_AREAS generation"
+      NEEDS_UPDATE=true
+      ;;
+    components/top-page/*|app/*/\(main\)/page.tsx)
+      AFFECTED_AREAS="$AFFECTED_AREAS top-page"
+      NEEDS_UPDATE=true
+      ;;
+    prisma/schema.prisma|auth.*|middleware.ts|actions/token-*|messages/*)
+      AFFECTED_AREAS="$AFFECTED_AREAS overview"
+      NEEDS_UPDATE=true
+      ;;
+  esac
+done <<< "$CHANGED_FILES"
+
+if [ "$NEEDS_UPDATE" = true ]; then
+  # Deduplicate areas
+  UNIQUE_AREAS=$(echo "$AFFECTED_AREAS" | tr ' ' '\n' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ' | xargs)
+
+  cat <<EOF
+Product docs may need updating. Affected areas: $UNIQUE_AREAS
+Run /update-product-docs to check and update documentation.
+EOF
+fi
+
+exit 0

+# Create Feature Documentation
+
+Create a new product documentation file under `docs/product/`. This skill handles Level 1 (feature area overview) and Level 2 (topic deep-dive) documents.
+
+## Arguments
+
+Parse `$ARGUMENTS` as: `<area-name> <doc-type> [topic-name]`
+
+- `area-name`: The feature area (e.g., `canvas`, `video`, `ai-tools`, `generation`, `top-page`, or a new area name)
+- `doc-type`: Either `feature` (Level 1 `_index.md`) or `topic` (Level 2 deep-dive)
+- `topic-name`: Required for `topic` type. The topic slug (e.g., `toolbar-tools`, `object-types`)
+
+### Examples
+
+```
+/create-feature-doc chat feature
+/create-feature-doc canvas topic layer-system
+/create-feature-doc generation topic controlnet
+```
+
+## Process
+
+### Step 1: Read conventions and template
+
+1. Read `docs/product/_conventions.md` for writing rules
+2. For `feature` type: read `docs/product/_templates/feature-area.md`
+3. For `topic` type: read `docs/product/_templates/topic-deep-dive.md`
+
+### Step 2: Research the codebase
+
+Before writing, gather real information:
+
+1. **Find route files**: Search `app/[locale]/` for the feature's page files
+2. **Find store files**: Search `store/` for related state management
+3. **Find components**: Search `components/` for the feature's UI components
+4. **Find actions**: Search `actions/` for server actions
+5. **Find API routes**: Search `app/api/` for related endpoints
+6. **Find hooks**: Search `hooks/` for feature-specific hooks
+7. **Check Prisma schema**: Search `prisma/schema.prisma` for related models
+8. **Find tests**: Search `tests/` for related test files
+9. **Check existing docs**: Search `docs/` for technical docs to cross-reference
+
+### Step 3: Create the document
+
+1. Copy the template
+2. Replace ALL `UPPERCASE_PLACEHOLDER` values with real content from codebase research
+3. Set `last_updated` to today's date
+4. Set `area` to the area name
+5. Fill code entry points table with verified file paths (confirm each file exists)
+6. Fill data models table from actual Prisma schema
+7. Fill test inventory from actual test files found
+8. Add proper See Also links
+
+### Step 4: Output location
+
+- For `feature` type: `docs/product/<area-name>/_index.md`
+- For `topic` type: `docs/product/<area-name>/<topic-name>.md`
+
+Create the directory if it doesn't exist.
+
+### Step 5: Update parent index
+
+- For `feature` type: Update `docs/product/_index.md` to include the new area in the Feature Areas table
+- For `topic` type: Update `docs/product/<area-name>/_index.md` to include the new topic in the Topics table
+

+
+Before finishing, verify:
+
+- [ ] YAML frontmatter has all required fields (`area`, `level`, `last_updated`, `status`)
+- [ ] All file paths in tables actually exist in the codebase
+- [ ] No `TODO` or `UPPERCASE_PLACEHOLDER` values remain
+- [ ] See Also section has parent link and relevant sibling links
+- [ ] Pure GFM markdown (no MDX/JSX/HTML)
+- [ ] Max 4 heading levels
+- [ ] Parent `_index.md` updated with link to new document

+
+# Create User Journey Documentation
+
+Create a new Level 3 user journey document under `docs/product/<area>/journeys/`.
+
+## Arguments
+
+Parse `$ARGUMENTS` as: `<area-name> <journey-slug>`
+
+- `area-name`: The feature area (e.g., `canvas`, `video`, `ai-tools`, `generation`, `top-page`)
+- `journey-slug`: The journey identifier in lowercase-with-hyphens (e.g., `text-to-image`, `chat-brainstorm`)
+
+### Examples
+
+```
+/create-journey-doc canvas resize-and-crop
+/create-journey-doc generation controlnet-workflow
+/create-journey-doc video trim-and-edit
+```
+
+## Process
+
+### Step 1: Read conventions and template
+
+1. Read `docs/product/_conventions.md` for writing rules
+2. Read `docs/product/_templates/user-journey.md` for the template structure
+3. Read `docs/product/<area-name>/_index.md` to understand the feature area context
+
+### Step 2: Research the user flow
+
+Trace the complete user flow through the codebase:
+
+1. **Identify the entry point**: Find the UI component where the journey starts (button, page, menu item)
+2. **Trace each user action**: For every step the user takes, find:
+   - **UI layer**: The React component rendering the interaction
+   - **Hook layer**: Any custom hooks managing the interaction logic
+   - **Store layer**: Zustand store actions/selectors involved
+   - **API layer**: API route handlers called
+   - **Action layer**: Server actions or ComfyUI workflow functions
+3. **Find error handling**: Look for try/catch blocks, error toasts, fallback UI
+4. **Find alternate flows**: Conditional branches, feature flags, permission checks
+5. **Check token costs**: Look for token deduction logic in the flow
+6. **Find test coverage**: Search `tests/` for tests covering this flow
+
+### Step 3: Create the document
+
+Output file: `docs/product/<area-name>/journeys/<journey-slug>.md`
+
+Create the directory if it doesn't exist.
+
+1. Copy the user journey template
+2. Set frontmatter:
+   - `area: <area-name>`
+   - `level: 3`
+   - `journey: <journey-slug>`
+   - `last_updated: <today's date>`
+   - `status: draft`
+3. Write a clear summary of what the user accomplishes
+4. List preconditions (authentication, required state, prerequisites)
+5. For EACH step:
+   - Describe the user action in plain language
+   - Fill the code path table with verified file paths and real function/component names
+   - Describe the result the user sees
+6. Document alternate flows with divergence points
+7. Fill error scenarios table
+8. Fill test coverage table with actual test files
+9. Add See Also with parent `_index.md` and related journeys
+
+### Step 4: Update parent index
+
+Update `docs/product/<area-name>/_index.md` to include the new journey in the User Journeys table.
+
+## Code Path Table Rules
+
+Every step MUST have a code path table. Include only the layers that are involved:
+
+| Layer  | File                             | Function/Component |
+| ------ | -------------------------------- | ------------------ |
+| UI     | `/components/area/component.tsx` | `ComponentName`    |
+| Hook   | `/hooks/use-hook.ts`             | `useHookName`      |
+| Store  | `/store/store.ts`                | `actionName`       |
+| API    | `/app/api/endpoint/route.ts`     | `POST handler`     |
+| Action | `/actions/action.ts`             | `functionName`     |
+
+- Every file path must be verified to exist in the codebase
+- Function/component names must match actual exports
+- Omit layers not involved in a step (not every step hits all layers)
+
+## Quality Checklist
+
+Before finishing, verify:
+
+- [ ] YAML frontmatter has all required fields including `journey`
+- [ ] Every step has a code path table with verified file paths
+- [ ] All referenced files actually exist in the codebase
+- [ ] No `TODO` or `UPPERCASE_PLACEHOLDER` values remain
+- [ ] Alternate flows documented if any conditional branches exist
+- [ ] Error scenarios table filled with real error cases
+- [ ] Test coverage table references actual test files
+- [ ] See Also section has parent link and related journey links
+- [ ] Parent `_index.md` updated with link to new journey

+---
+name: update-product-docs
+description: Review code changes and update affected product documentation in docs/product/. Use after code changes or when creating PRs.
+allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash
+---
+
+# Update Product Documentation
+
+Analyze recent code changes and update any affected product documentation in `docs/product/`.
+
+## Arguments
+
+`$ARGUMENTS` is optional and can be:
+
+- Empty: analyze all uncommitted changes (`git diff` + `git diff --cached`)
+- A branch name: analyze changes between that branch and HEAD
+- A file path: analyze changes to a specific file and update related docs
+
+## Process
+
+### Step 1: Identify code changes
+
+1. If no arguments: run `git diff` and `git diff --cached` to find all changed files
+2. If branch name: run `git diff <branch>...HEAD --name-only`
+3. If file path: use just that file
+
+Collect the list of changed files.
+
+### Step 2: Map changes to documentation
+
+For each changed file, determine which docs it might affect:
+
+| Changed File Pattern           | Affected Docs                                                     |
+| ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| `components/canvas/*`          | `docs/product/canvas/`                                            |
+| `store/canvas-*`               | `docs/product/canvas/`                                            |
+| `hooks/use-canvas-*`           | `docs/product/canvas/`                                            |
+| `app/[locale]/**/canvas/*`     | `docs/product/canvas/`                                            |
+| `components/video/*`           | `docs/product/video/`                                             |
+| `store/video-*`                | `docs/product/video/`                                             |
+| `actions/ai-tool*`             | `docs/product/ai-tools/`                                          |
+| `components/ai-tool*`          | `docs/product/ai-tools/`                                          |
+| `actions/comfyui/*`            | `docs/product/generation/`                                        |
+| `app/[locale]/**/generate/*`   | `docs/product/generation/`                                        |
+| `store/sketch-to-image/*`      | `docs/product/generation/`                                        |
+| `components/top-page/*`        | `docs/product/top-page/`                                          |
+| `app/[locale]/(main)/page.tsx` | `docs/product/top-page/`                                          |
+| `prisma/schema.prisma`         | Check all areas for affected models                               |
+| `auth.*`, `middleware.ts`      | `docs/product/overview/cross-cutting-concerns.md`                 |
+| `messages/*`                   | `docs/product/overview/cross-cutting-concerns.md` (i18n section)  |
+| `actions/token-*`              | `docs/product/overview/cross-cutting-concerns.md` (token section) |
+
+### Step 3: Check each affected doc
+
+For each potentially affected doc:
+
+1. Read the current doc
+2. Check if any referenced file paths have changed (renamed, moved, deleted)
+3. Check if any referenced components/functions have been renamed or removed
+4. Check if new components/routes/actions were added that should be documented
+5. Check if behavior described in the doc has changed
+
+### Step 4: Apply updates
+
+For each doc that needs changes:
+
+1. Update file paths in code entry points and code path tables
+2. Update component/function names if renamed
+3. Add new entries for new components/routes/actions
+4. Remove entries for deleted code
+5. Update `last_updated` date in frontmatter to today
+6. If a doc references a file that no longer exists, fix or remove the reference
+
+### Step 5: Report
+
+Output a summary of what was updated:
+
+```
+## Documentation Update Summary
+
+### Changed Source Files
+- list of changed files
+
+### Updated Docs
+- docs/product/canvas/_index.md: Updated toolbar component path
+- docs/product/canvas/journeys/chat-brainstorm.md: Added new tool call step
+
+### No Changes Needed
+- docs/product/video/_index.md: No affected references
+
+### New Docs Recommended
+- Consider creating: docs/product/canvas/journeys/new-feature.md
+  (new user flow added in components/canvas/new-feature.tsx)
+```
+
+## What NOT to Do
+
+- Do NOT rewrite entire documents for minor path changes
+- Do NOT change doc structure or add new sections unless the code change warrants it
+- Do NOT update `last_updated` if no actual content changed
+- Do NOT create new documents without asking the user first (just recommend them)

+# Update Product Documentation
+

+
+## Arguments
+
+`$ARGUMENTS` is optional and can be:
+
+- Empty: analyze all uncommitted changes (`git diff` + `git diff --cached`)
+- A branch name: analyze changes between that branch and HEAD
+- A file path: analyze changes to a specific file and update related docs
+
+## Process
+
+### Step 1: Identify code changes
+
+1. If no arguments: run `git diff` and `git diff --cached` to find all changed files
+2. If branch name: run `git diff <branch>...HEAD --name-only`
+3. If file path: use just that file
+
+Collect the list of changed files.
+
+### Step 2: Map changes to documentation
+
+For each changed file, determine which docs it might affect:
+
+| Changed File Pattern           | Affected Docs                                                     |
+| ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| `components/canvas/*`          | `docs/product/canvas/`                                            |
+| `store/canvas-*`               | `docs/product/canvas/`                                            |
+| `hooks/use-canvas-*`           | `docs/product/canvas/`                                            |
+| `app/[locale]/**/canvas/*`     | `docs/product/canvas/`                                            |
+| `components/video/*`           | `docs/product/video/`                                             |
+| `store/video-*`                | `docs/product/video/`                                             |
+| `actions/ai-tool*`             | `docs/product/ai-tools/`                                          |
+| `components/ai-tool*`          | `docs/product/ai-tools/`                                          |
+| `actions/comfyui/*`            | `docs/product/generation/`                                        |
+| `app/[locale]/**/generate/*`   | `docs/product/generation/`                                        |
+| `store/sketch-to-image/*`      | `docs/product/generation/`                                        |
+| `components/top-page/*`        | `docs/product/top-page/`                                          |
+| `app/[locale]/(main)/page.tsx` | `docs/product/top-page/`                                          |
+| `prisma/schema.prisma`         | Check all areas for affected models                               |
+| `auth.*`, `middleware.ts`      | `docs/product/overview/cross-cutting-concerns.md`                 |
+| `messages/*`                   | `docs/product/overview/cross-cutting-concerns.md` (i18n section)  |
+| `actions/token-*`              | `docs/product/overview/cross-cutting-concerns.md` (token section) |
+
+### Step 3: Check each affected doc
+
+For each potentially affected doc:
+
+1. Read the current doc
+2. Check if any referenced file paths have changed (renamed, moved, deleted)
+3. Check if any referenced components/functions have been renamed or removed
+4. Check if new components/routes/actions were added that should be documented
+5. Check if behavior described in the doc has changed
+
+### Step 4: Apply updates
+
+For each doc that needs changes:
+
+1. Update file paths in code entry points and code path tables
+2. Update component/function names if renamed
+3. Add new entries for new components/routes/actions
+4. Remove entries for deleted code
+5. Update `last_updated` date in frontmatter to today
+6. If a doc references a file that no longer exists, fix or remove the reference
+

+

+

+- docs/product/canvas/_index.md: Updated toolbar component path
+- docs/product/canvas/journeys/chat-brainstorm.md: Added new tool call step
+
+### No Changes Needed
+- docs/product/video/_index.md: No affected references
+
+### New Docs Recommended
+- Consider creating: docs/product/canvas/journeys/new-feature.md
+  (new user flow added in components/canvas/new-feature.tsx)
+```
+
+## What NOT to Do
+
+- Do NOT rewrite entire documents for minor path changes
+- Do NOT change doc structure or add new sections unless the code change warrants it
+- Do NOT update `last_updated` if no actual content changed
+- Do NOT create new documents without asking the user first (just recommend them)
